samples.title: Cantilever: Concentrated Force
samples.description: Concentrated force F applied at the free end, giving the linear bending diagram M(x) = -F (l - x) and constant shear V = F.

samples.title: Cantilever: Concentrated Moment
samples.description: Concentrated moment M_0 applied at the free end, producing a constant bending moment along the beam and zero shear.

samples.title: Cantilever: Linearly Distributed Load
samples.description: Distributed load varying linearly between intensities q_1 at the support and q_2 at the tip, giving a cubic bending diagram and quadratic shear.

samples.title: Cantilever: Partially Distributed Load
samples.description: Uniform load q acting on a stretch of length b adjacent to the free end, with the unloaded portion a = l - b kept clear.

samples.title: Cantilever: Uniformly Distributed Load
samples.description: Full-span uniform load q giving the textbook support actions M = q l^2 / 2 and V = q l.

samples.title: Continuous Beam: Force Method under Uniform Load
samples.description: Force-method analysis of a multi-span continuous beam under a uniform load q, building the flexibility matrix from bending and shear integrals and solving for the redundant reactions, internal forces and deflections.

samples.title: Deflection: Cantilever under Uniform Load
samples.description: Cantilever under a full-span uniform load q, integrating the curvature to obtain φ(x) and d(x) with the tip deflection d_max = q l^4 / (8 E I).

samples.title: Deflection: Cantilever with a Tip Load
samples.description: Rotation φ(x) and deflection d(x) along a cantilever loaded by a tip force F, recovering the textbook tip values φ_max = F l^2 / (2 E I) and d_max = F l^3 / (3 E I).

samples.title: Deflection: Simply Supported Beam under Uniform Load
samples.file: samples/Structural/Deflections/Simply Supported Beam with Unifrom Load.cpd
samples.upstream: Examples/Structural/Deflections/Simply Supported Beam with Unifrom Load.cpd
samples.description: Simply supported beam under a full-span uniform load q, recovering the serviceability-relevant mid-span deflection d_max = 5 q l^4 / (384 E I) and the support rotation φ_max = q l^3 / (24 E I).

samples.title: Deflection: Simply Supported Beam with a Mid-Span Load
samples.file: samples/Structural/Deflections/Simply Supported Beam with Concentrated Load.cpd
samples.upstream: Examples/Structural/Deflections/Simply Supported Beam with Concentrated Load.cpd
samples.description: Simply supported beam with a mid-span point force F, giving the maximum deflection d_max = F l^3 / (48 E I) and the support rotation φ_max = F l^2 / (16 E I).

samples.title: Fully Restrained Beam: Concentrated Force
samples.description: Fixed-end moments M_A = F a b^2 / l^2 and M_B = F a^2 b / l^2 for a clamped-clamped beam carrying a point force F at distance a from the left support.

samples.title: Fully Restrained Beam: Concentrated Moment
samples.description: Fully restrained beam loaded by a concentrated moment M at distance a, with a constant shear V = 6 M a b / l^3 and a step in the bending diagram across the load.

samples.title: Fully Restrained Beam: Linearly Distributed Load
samples.description: Trapezoidal load between intensities q_1 and q_2, with the support moments split as (3 q_1 + 2 q_2) l^2 / 60 and (2 q_1 + 3 q_2) l^2 / 60.

samples.title: Fully Restrained Beam: Partially Distributed Load
samples.description: Uniform load q over a stretch of length b between offsets a and c = l - a - b, with a guard against an invalid configuration when a + b > l.

samples.title: Fully Restrained Beam: Uniformly Distributed Load
samples.description: Full-span uniform load q, recovering M_A = M_B = q l^2 / 12, V_A = V_B = q l / 2 and the mid-span M_max = q l^2 / 24.

samples.title: Propped Cantilever: Concentrated Force
samples.description: Force-method solution for a propped cantilever carrying a point force F at distance a from the fixed support, with the in-span peak at the load position.

samples.title: Propped Cantilever: Concentrated Moment
samples.description: Propped cantilever loaded by a concentrated moment M at distance a, giving a constant shear and a bending diagram with a jump of M across the load section.

samples.title: Propped Cantilever: Linearly Distributed Load
samples.description: Propped cantilever under a trapezoidal load defined by end intensities q_1 and q_2, locating the in-span peak from the zero of the shear V(x).

samples.title: Propped Cantilever: Partially Distributed Load
samples.description: Propped cantilever with a uniform load q acting on a stretch of length b between offsets a and c = l - a - b from the supports.

samples.title: Propped Cantilever: Uniformly Distributed Load
samples.description: Full-span uniform load q on a propped cantilever, giving the textbook results M_A = q l^2 / 8, V_A = 5 q l / 8 and M_max = 9 q l^2 / 128 at x = 5 l / 8.

samples.title: Simply Supported Beam: Concentrated Force
samples.description: Single point force F at distance a from the left support, with reactions V_A = F (l - a) / l, V_B = -F a / l and the bending peak M_max = F (l - a) a / l at the load.

samples.title: Simply Supported Beam: Concentrated Moment
samples.description: Concentrated moment M applied at distance a, giving a constant shear V = M / l and a bending diagram with a step of M at the load section.

samples.title: Simply Supported Beam: Linearly Distributed Load
samples.description: Trapezoidal load defined by end intensities q_1 and q_2, locating the in-span peak from the zero of V(x) and falling back to the uniform and triangular special cases.

samples.title: Simply Supported Beam: Partially Distributed Load
samples.description: Uniform load q acting on a stretch of length b between offsets a and c = l - a - b, with a guard against an invalid load length when a + b > l.

samples.title: Simply Supported Beam: Several Concentrated Forces
samples.description: Series of n equal forces F spaced at a = l / (n + 1), with M_max taken at mid-span and switching between the odd-n and even-n closed forms.

samples.title: Simply Supported Beam: Uniformly Distributed Load
samples.description: Full-span uniform load q, recovering the textbook results M_max = q l^2 / 8 and V_max = q l / 2.

samples.title: Areas of Reinforcement Bars
samples.description: Lookup table that returns the total reinforcement area A_s for a chosen bar diameter and bar count, with the cells highlighting the picked combination on hover.

samples.title: Bending Capacity of Tee Section
samples.file: samples/Structural/Reinforced Concrete/Bending Capacity of Tee Section.cpd
samples.upstream: Examples/Structural/Reinforced Concrete/Bending Capacity of Tee Section.cpd
samples.description: Bending capacity M_Rd of a T-cross-section with given reinforcement: rectangular stress block, neutral-axis depth from horizontal equilibrium and lever arm to the resultant of the compressed concrete.

samples.title: Bending Design of Rectangular Section
samples.file: samples/Structural/Reinforced Concrete/Bending Design of Rectangular Section.cpd
samples.upstream: Examples/Structural/Reinforced Concrete/Bending Design of Rectangular Section.cpd
samples.description: Required tension reinforcement A_s of a rectangular section under a design moment M_Ed, with compression reinforcement added when the relative neutral-axis depth exceeds the ductility limit.

samples.title: Bending Design of Tee Section
samples.file: samples/Structural/Reinforced Concrete/Bending Design of Tee Section.cpd
samples.upstream: Examples/Structural/Reinforced Concrete/Bending Design of Tee Section.cpd
samples.description: Required tension reinforcement A_s of a T-section under a design moment M_Ed, switching between rectangular flange-only behaviour and T-section behaviour according to the position of the neutral axis.

samples.title: Column Design for Bending and Axial Force
samples.file: samples/Structural/Reinforced Concrete/Column Design for Bending and Axial Force.cpd
samples.upstream: Examples/Structural/Reinforced Concrete/Column Design for Bending and Axial Force.cpd
samples.description: Verification of a rectangular reinforced concrete column under bending and axial force from the strain compatibility, with symmetric or asymmetric reinforcement and the strut compression check.

samples.title: Column Design for Biaxial Bending and Axial Force
samples.file: samples/Structural/Reinforced Concrete/Column Design for Biaxial Bending and Axial Force.cpd
samples.upstream: Examples/Structural/Reinforced Concrete/Column Design for Biaxial Bending and Axial Force.cpd
samples.description: Verification of a rectangular reinforced concrete column under axial force and bending about both axes by superposition of the two uniaxial interaction surfaces with the EN 1992-1-1 power-law combination.

samples.title: Column Design for Biaxial Bending and Axial Force (with Units)
samples.file: samples/Structural/Reinforced Concrete/Column Design for Biaxial Bending and Axial Force (with Units).cpd
samples.upstream: Examples/Structural/Reinforced Concrete/Column Design for Biaxial Bending and Axial Force (with Units).cpd
samples.description: Biaxial bending check of a rectangular column with the same strain-compatibility model as the uniaxial worksheet, expressed entirely with explicit CalcpadCE units so that the input fields use cm or mm directly.

samples.title: Combined Bending, Shear and Torsion
samples.file: samples/Structural/Reinforced Concrete/Combined Bending, Shear and Torsion.cpd
samples.upstream: Examples/Structural/Reinforced Concrete/Combined Bending, Shear and Torsion.cpd
samples.description: Combined bending, shear and torsion design of a T-beam: variable-strut-inclination model for the shear contribution, space-truss model for the torsional resistance and superposition for the longitudinal reinforcement.

samples.title: Interaction Diagram of RC Section
samples.file: samples/Structural/Reinforced Concrete/Interaction Diagram of RC Section.cpd
samples.upstream: Examples/Structural/Reinforced Concrete/Interaction Diagram of RC Section.cpd
samples.description: N-M interaction diagram of a symmetrically reinforced rectangular section, generated by sweeping the neutral-axis depth from pure compression to pure tension and plotting the resulting axial force and bending moment.

samples.title: Shear Design of Rectangular Section
samples.file: samples/Structural/Reinforced Concrete/Shear Design of Rectangular Section.cpd
samples.upstream: Examples/Structural/Reinforced Concrete/Shear Design of Rectangular Section.cpd
samples.description: Shear design of a rectangular section under EN 1992-1-1: shear strength without links V_Rd,c, required link area for a strut angle θ and check of the maximum strut compression.

samples.title: SLS Design of Beam with Rectangular Section
samples.file: samples/Structural/Reinforced Concrete/SLS Design of Beam with Rectangular Section.cpd
samples.upstream: Examples/Structural/Reinforced Concrete/SLS Design of Beam with Rectangular Section.cpd
samples.description: Serviceability checks for a rectangular beam: stress in the concrete and reinforcement, crack-width and long-term deflection, with the static scheme selected from a drop-down list (only in the Desktop version) of cantilevers and simply supported beams.

samples.title: SLS Design of Beam with Tee Section
samples.file: samples/Structural/Reinforced Concrete/SLS Design of Beam with Tee Section.cpd
samples.upstream: Examples/Structural/Reinforced Concrete/SLS Design of Beam with Tee Section.cpd
samples.description: Serviceability checks for a T-beam: same stress, crack-width and deflection verifications as the rectangular variant, with the cracked-section second moment of area derived for both flange-in-compression and web-in-compression cases.

samples.title: Two-Way Slab Panel: All Edges Restrained
samples.file: samples/Structural/Reinforced Concrete - Plates/Fully Restrained Slab Panel.cpd
samples.upstream: Examples/Structural/Reinforced Concrete - Plates/Fully Restrained Slab Panel.cpd
samples.description: Two-way slab panel with all four edges fully restrained: span and support moment coefficients tabulated against the aspect ratio, with the required reinforcement in both directions.

samples.title: Two-Way Slab Panel: All Edges Simply Supported
samples.file: samples/Structural/Reinforced Concrete - Plates/Simply Supported Slab Panel.cpd
samples.upstream: Examples/Structural/Reinforced Concrete - Plates/Simply Supported Slab Panel.cpd
samples.description: Two-way slab panel simply supported on all four edges, the limiting case of the family with the highest span moments and no support reinforcement requirement.

samples.title: Two-Way Slab Panel: Restrained Adjacent Edges
samples.description: Two-way slab panel with two adjacent edges restrained and the other two simply supported, typical of a corner panel of a floor system.

samples.title: Two-Way Slab Panel: Restrained Both Longer Edges
samples.file: samples/Structural/Reinforced Concrete - Plates/Restrained Both Longer Edges.cpd
samples.upstream: Examples/Structural/Reinforced Concrete - Plates/Restrained Both Longer Edges.cpd
samples.description: Two-way slab panel with both longer edges restrained and the two shorter edges simply supported, typical of an interior panel of a one-way-spanning floor strip.

samples.title: Two-Way Slab Panel: Restrained Both Shorter Edges
samples.file: samples/Structural/Reinforced Concrete - Plates/Restrained Both Shorter Edges.cpd
samples.upstream: Examples/Structural/Reinforced Concrete - Plates/Restrained Both Shorter Edges.cpd
samples.description: Two-way slab panel with both shorter edges restrained and the two longer edges simply supported, typical of an end panel oriented across the short span.

samples.title: Two-Way Slab Panel: Restrained Longer Edge
samples.description: Two-way slab panel with one longer edge restrained and the other three simply supported, typical of an edge panel oriented along the long span.

samples.title: Two-Way Slab Panel: Restrained Panel with Unrestrained Longer Edge
samples.file: samples/Structural/Reinforced Concrete - Plates/Restrained Panel with Unrestrained Longer Edge.cpd
samples.upstream: Examples/Structural/Reinforced Concrete - Plates/Restrained Panel with Unrestrained Longer Edge.cpd
samples.description: Two-way slab panel restrained on three sides with the longer edge left free, typical of a balcony or canopy oriented along the long span.

samples.title: Two-Way Slab Panel: Restrained Panel with Unrestrained Shorter Edge
samples.file: samples/Structural/Reinforced Concrete - Plates/Restrained Panel with Unrestrained Shorter Edge.cpd
samples.upstream: Examples/Structural/Reinforced Concrete - Plates/Restrained Panel with Unrestrained Shorter Edge.cpd
samples.description: Two-way slab panel restrained on three sides with the shorter edge left free, typical of a balcony or canopy oriented across the short span.

samples.title: Two-Way Slab Panel: Restrained Shorter Edge
samples.description: Two-way slab panel with one shorter edge restrained and the other three simply supported, typical of an edge panel oriented across the short span.

samples.title: Punching Shear: Corner Column
samples.description: Punching shear verification of a flat slab around a corner column: control perimeter on two sides only, eccentricity factor for a corner support and required punching reinforcement when the slab capacity is exceeded.

samples.title: Punching Shear: Edge Column
samples.description: Punching shear verification of a flat slab around an edge column: open control perimeter on three sides, eccentricity factor for an edge support and design of the punching reinforcement.

samples.title: Punching Shear: Internal Column
samples.description: Punching shear verification of a flat slab around an internal column: closed control perimeter, slab strength without and with shear reinforcement, and required area of stirrups, studs or bent-up bars.

samples.title: Seismic Detailing (DCM): Beam
samples.file: samples/Structural/Reinforced Concrete - Seismic Detailing/Beam Detailing for DCM.cpd
samples.upstream: Examples/Structural/Reinforced Concrete - Seismic Detailing/Beam Detailing for DCM.cpd
samples.description: Eurocode 8 detailing of a primary seismic beam for medium ductility class: critical region length l_cr, longitudinal ratio limits, spacing of closed stirrups and lap-splice requirements.

samples.title: Seismic Detailing (DCM): Column
samples.file: samples/Structural/Reinforced Concrete - Seismic Detailing/Column Detailing for DCM.cpd
samples.upstream: Examples/Structural/Reinforced Concrete - Seismic Detailing/Column Detailing for DCM.cpd
samples.description: Eurocode 8 detailing of a primary seismic column for medium ductility class: cross-section dimensions, longitudinal ratio, confinement of the boundary regions and minimum mechanical volumetric ratio of the hoops.

samples.title: Seismic Detailing (DCM): Shear Wall
samples.file: samples/Structural/Reinforced Concrete - Seismic Detailing/Shear Wall Detailing for DCM.cpd
samples.upstream: Examples/Structural/Reinforced Concrete - Seismic Detailing/Shear Wall Detailing for DCM.cpd
samples.description: Eurocode 8 detailing of a primary seismic shear wall for medium ductility class: confined boundary elements at the wall ends, web horizontal and vertical reinforcement and curvature ductility check at the wall base.

samples.title: I-Section Properties
samples.description: Cross-section properties of an asymmetric or built-up I-section computed from seven user-supplied dimensions, with classification per Eurocode EN 1993-1-1 and elastic and plastic section moduli for both axes.

samples.title: I-Section Properties from a Catalogue, with Drawing
samples.description: Catalogue-driven variant of the I-section properties calculation: a single drop-down selector populates the dimensions and an SVG sketch of the chosen rolled section is rendered alongside the results.

samples.title: I-Section Properties from an Excel Catalogue
samples.description: Excel-driven variant: the rolled-section dimensions are read from Steel Sections EN.xlsx by the read directive, selected by an integer identifier that maps to a row in the IPE or HE database.

samples.title: Pad Footing: Optimised Plan Dimensions
samples.description: Numerical sizing of a rectangular foundation pad under axial force and biaxial bending: the side-ratio k = a / b that minimises the base area while keeping the maximum stress below the permissible value and avoiding uplift is found with the embedded Inf solver.

samples.title: Snow Drift at a Taller Building (EN 1991-1-3)
samples.description: Eurocode EN 1991-1-3 snow drift on a roof abutting a taller construction: drift length l_s, sliding coefficient μ_s and wind coefficient μ_w from the geometry of the higher and lower roofs.

samples.title: Snow Load on Monopitch and Duopitch Roofs (EN 1991-1-3)
samples.description: Eurocode EN 1991-1-3 snow load on monopitch and duopitch roofs: shape coefficient μ_1 selected from the pitch angle and combined with exposure and thermal factors.

samples.title: Wind Load on a Duopitch Building (EN 1991-1-4)
samples.description: Eurocode EN 1991-1-4 wind on a rectangular building with duopitch roof: peak velocity pressure, zone-by-zone external pressure coefficients and reduction to line loads on columns, beams and purlins.

samples.title: Multi-Storey RC Frame Analysis
samples.description: Five-storey three-bay reinforced concrete frame with T-section beams, programmatically generated joints and elements, and Eurocode load combinations on dead, live and self-weight contributions.

samples.title: Plane Frame Analysis: Prismatic Members
samples.description: Plane frame analysis with prismatic arbitrary cross-sections, assembling local 6x6 stiffness matrices with axial, bending and shear contributions and solving the global system by Cholesky decomposition.

samples.title: Plane Frame Analysis: Tapered Members
samples.description: Plane frame with linearly tapered members: each element stiffness coefficient is obtained by integrating 1 / EA(x), x / EI(x) and 1 / GA_Q(x) along the element length.

samples.title: Drop-Weight Impact on an RC Beam (Animated)
samples.description: Drop-weight impact of a steel ball on a simply supported reinforced concrete beam: SDOF and 11-node MDOF modal superposition with Rayleigh damping, Hertzian impact contact duration and Duhamel integration of the impulse force.

samples.title: Free Vibrations of a Tapered Steel Pole
samples.file: samples/Structural/Structural Dynamics/Free Vibrations of Steel Pole.cpd
samples.upstream: Examples/Structural/Structural Dynamics/Free Vibrations of Steel Pole.cpd
samples.description: Tapered cantilever pole with selectable cross-section shape; flexibility matrix built by integration of bending and shear along the height, three lowest natural frequencies, with the fundamental period checked against ASCE SEI 7/22.

samples.title: Free Vibrations of a Tapered Steel Pole (Plotly Animation)
samples.file: samples/Structural/Structural Dynamics/Free Vibrations of Steel Pole Plotly Animated.cpd
samples.upstream: Examples/Structural/Structural Dynamics/Free Vibrations of Steel Pole Plotly Animated.cpd
samples.description: Tapered steel pole free-vibration analysis with the mode shapes animated in the browser by Plotly, smoothly interpolating between the positive and negative amplitude of each mode.

samples.title: Free Vibrations of a Tapered Steel Pole (SVG Animation)
samples.file: samples/Structural/Structural Dynamics/Free Vibrations of Steel Pole Animated.cpd
samples.upstream: Examples/Structural/Structural Dynamics/Free Vibrations of Steel Pole Animated.cpd
samples.description: Same tapered steel pole as the static variant, with the lower mode shapes animated in pure SVG by frame switching driven by a small inline jQuery script.

samples.title: Prestressed Biot Truss: Material and Geometric Nonlinearity
samples.file: samples/Structural/Nonlinear/Material and Geometric Nonlinear Analysis of Prestressed Asymmetric Biot Truss.cpd
samples.upstream: Examples/Structural/Nonlinear/Material and Geometric Nonlinear Analysis of Prestressed Asymmetric Biot Truss.cpd
samples.description: Combined material and geometric nonlinear analysis of a prestressed three-joint truss with a bilinear elastic-plastic stress-strain law, solved by a global Newton-Raphson iteration that updates the Jacobi matrix and the axial stiffness E A at each step.

samples.title: Von Mises Truss: Nonlinear Analysis (Animated)
samples.file: samples/Structural/Nonlinear/Nonlinear Analysis of a Von-Mises Truss Animated.cpd
samples.upstream: Examples/Structural/Nonlinear/Nonlinear Analysis of a Von-Mises Truss Animated.cpd
samples.description: Shallow Von-Mises truss with circular pipe section, animated load-displacement curve passing through a limit point, solved by fixed-point iteration, Newton-Raphson, the secant method and the built-in Root solver.

samples.title: Soil Stress and Deformations
samples.description: Stresses and settlement in an elastic half-space under a trapezoidal surface pressure on a rectangular footprint, obtained by numerical integration of the Boussinesq point-load kernel for σ_z, τ_xz and τ_yz.

samples.title: Built-up Section Properties
samples.description: Vectors and hprod give the centroid and second moment of area of a built-up section with units carried through, and a bending stress follows.

samples.title: Currency Units
samples.description: Defines USD, EUR and other currencies as custom units with cross-rates, so monetary expressions auto-convert and round consistently across the worksheet.

samples.title: Information Units
samples.description: Defines bit, byte and the binary prefixes (KiB, MiB, GiB, TiB) as custom units, ready for bandwidth and storage calculations.

samples.title: Deep Beam: Elastic Series Solution
samples.description: Plane-stress analysis of a simply-supported deep beam under a partial uniform load, using a sine-series decomposition of the load and reaction. Recovers σ_x, σ_y and τ_xy for arbitrary length, height, load span and support width — an analytical baseline for FE checks.

samples.title: Rectangular Plate: Navier Solution
samples.description: Navier double-trig-series solution for a thin rectangular plate on simple supports under uniform load. Returns maximum deflection and bending moments M_x, M_y for arbitrary plan dimensions, thickness and elastic constants — a quick parametric check against slab FEA.

samples.title: Saint-Venant Torsion
samples.description: Closed-form Saint-Venant torsion of a rectangular cross-section, evaluating the shear-stress field τ_zx, τ_zy and torsional rigidity from a single Fourier series. A hand-check baseline for FE torsion models and for simplified rectangular-section design formulas.

samples.title: Deep Beam: Finite Element Analysis
samples.description: Plane-stress FEA of a deep beam using rectangular 8-DOF elements, with a partial uniform load and elastic supports modelled by a distributed-stiffness function. Recovers the σ_x, σ_y and τ_xy stress fields and the deflected shape on a parametric mesh.

samples.title: Flat Slab FEA
samples.description: Multi-span flat-slab analysis with the 16-DOF Bogner–Fox–Schmit plate element using numerical Gauss integration of the stiffness matrix. Handles arbitrary column grids and returns deflection together with the M_x and M_y bending-moment fields.

samples.title: Flat Slab FEA Optimized
samples.description: Same Bogner–Fox–Schmit flat-slab model, but with closed-form analytically integrated element matrices instead of Gauss quadrature. An order of magnitude faster on dense meshes — well suited for parametric studies and mesh-refinement sweeps.

samples.title: Rectangular Slab FEA
samples.description: Single-panel simply-supported rectangular slab solved with the 16-DOF Bogner–Fox–Schmit plate element under uniform load. Returns deflection plus the bending moments M_x and M_y on a user-defined mesh — a compact testbed for convergence studies.

samples.title: Getting Started: Calculating
samples.description: First steps: arithmetic, comparisons and calculations with variables.

samples.title: Getting Started: Functions and Plots
samples.description: Defines a function, plots it, and calculates values.

samples.title: Getting Started: Units and Conversion
samples.description: CalcpadCE handles unit conversion natively with SI and Imperial units. Units are checked for consistency to spot errors early.

samples.title: Double Interpolation
samples.description: Bilinear-style table lookup that chains 1D Hermite splines along both axes to interpolate a tabulated T(i, j) surface. The canonical pattern for evaluating two-input design tables on intermediate values.

samples.title: Interpolation of Functions
samples.description: Reconstructs an exponential and a trigonometric function from coarse samples using nearest-value, linear and Hermite-spline interpolation. A side-by-side accuracy comparison that quickly reveals overshoot, kinks and where the smooth spline pays off.

samples.title: Interpolation with take, line and spline
samples.description: Compares take(), line() and spline() on a single dataset, then derives wind-load height factors k_z for two terrain categories by interpolating tabulated code values. A compact reference for picking the right scheme when working with discrete engineering tables.

samples.title: Matrix Creational Functions
samples.description: Creational helpers for matrices: matrix, identity, diagonal, utriang, ltriang, symmetric, banded, random and Vandermonde constructors.

samples.title: Matrix Data Functions
samples.description: Data-oriented matrix toolkit: row- and column-wise sorting, ordering, search, plus the standard reductions (sum, product, min, max, mean).

samples.title: Matrix Initialization and Indexing
samples.description: Foundations of matrices in CalcpadCE: literal construction with | row separators, single- and double-index access, slicing, submatrix extraction and assignment by index.

samples.title: Matrix Math Functions
samples.description: Linear-algebra primitives: Hadamard product, determinant, inverse, transpose, trace, rank, L_p and Frobenius norms, plus solver and decomposition helpers.

samples.title: Matrix Operators
samples.description: Reference for matrix and matrix-vector operators: element-wise vs. algebraic multiplication, comparison and logical operators broadcast across whole grids.

samples.title: Matrix Structural Functions
samples.description: Structural plumbing for matrices: n_rows, n_cols, resize, join, reshape, submatrix and the slicing helpers that feed the rest of the toolkit.

samples.title: Cubic Roots Function
samples.description: Multiline cubic-roots function returning all three roots of x^3 + a x^2 + b x + c = 0 via the Cardano formula, with discriminant-based real/complex branching.

samples.title: Fibonacci Numbers
samples.description: Recursive multiline definition of the Fibonacci function fib(n), illustrating self-referential calls and conditional base cases.

samples.title: Greatest Common Divisor - Euclid Algorithm
samples.file: samples/Engineering/Multiline Functions/Greatest Common Divisor - Euclid Algorithm.cpd
samples.upstream: Examples/Engineering/Multiline Functions/Greatest Common Divisor - Euclid Algorithm.cpd
samples.description: Iterative greatest common divisor built around a while block, implementing the classical Euclid algorithm.

samples.title: Quadratic Roots Function
samples.description: Multiline quadratic-roots function returning both roots of a x^2 + b x + c = 0 via the discriminant, with real/complex branching.

samples.title: Monte Carlo Pi
samples.description: Estimates π by sampling random points in the unit square and counting those falling inside the quarter circle. Includes a live SVG plot of the sample cloud coloured by inside-versus-outside membership, so accuracy and variance can be eyeballed at any sample size.

samples.title: Newton's Method (Animated)
samples.description: Solves x^x = 10 with Newton iteration and renders an animated SVG that highlights each tangent step. The frame loop turns convergence into a visual sequence rather than a printed iteration table.

samples.title: Numerical Differentiation
samples.description: Compares the Slope operator (Richardson extrapolation) against Derivative (complex-step method) on e^x and sin(x^2) at large arguments. Exposes the round-off blow-up of finite differences and the machine-precision accuracy of the complex-step trick.

samples.title: Numerical Integration
samples.description: Evaluates ∫_-1^1√1-x^2 dx with three quadrature rules — Boole (Newton-Cotes), Gauss-Legendre and tanh-sinh — at five nodes. Tabulates the relative error of each scheme against the analytical result π/2.

samples.title: Rayleigh Quotient Iteration
samples.description: Computes the dominant eigenpair of a 3× 3 symmetric matrix via Rayleigh-quotient iteration. Each step solves a shifted linear system, normalises the iterate and rebuilds the eigenvalue from the quotient, achieving cubic convergence within a handful of steps.

samples.title: System of Nonlinear Equations
samples.description: Solves a 4-variable nonlinear system three ways — fixed-point iteration, Newton-Raphson with the analytical Jacobian, and Broyden quasi-Newton — converging on the same root with very different iteration counts and step sizes.

samples.title: Beam Explorer: Python Solve, Plotly Charts
samples.description: A three-span beam solved in Python (stiffness matrix, numpy, matplotlib) for several load cases and a moving point load; the results drive an interactive Plotly chart with hover values, a load case menu and sliders, and a Calcpad design check.

samples.title: Beam Moment Diagram with matplotlib
samples.description: A #python block draws the moment diagram of a simply supported beam with numpy and matplotlib and exports the maximum moment; the Calcpad lines after it check that moment against a capacity.

samples.title: Function Plot with matplotlib
samples.description: A #python block plots a damped oscillation and a bar chart side by side with matplotlib and exports the peak value.

samples.title: Plane Truss by the Stiffness Method
samples.file: samples/Python/Plane truss by the stiffness method.cpd
samples.upstream: own/Python/Plane truss by the stiffness method.cpd
samples.description: A statically determinate plane truss is assembled and solved in a #python block (global stiffness matrix in loops, np.linalg.solve), the member forces and reactions are recovered and drawn with matplotlib, and the Calcpad lines after the block check the governing members.
